'''Carl Norn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] technician living during the [[Great Galactic War]], who owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Bloodshot Rancor]]''. Norn made his friend [[Andronikos Revel]] first mate on the ship and got him into pirate racket, though Norn eventually lost the ship due to gambling problems. In [[3643 BBY]] Norn contacted Andronikos regarding a gambling debt and Revel settled his problems with a few well-aimed blaster shots.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carl Norn is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Andronikos Revel companion storyline.
